mechanism: Mefloquine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of testosterone, potentially increasing testosterone levels; additionally, both agents can affect CNS function and mefloquine's neuropsychiatric effects may be compounded by hormonal changes.
action: Monitor for signs of testosterone excess (polycythemia, fluid retention, mood changes) and mefloquine adverse effects (neuropsychiatric symptoms); consider alternative antimalarial if feasible or ensure close clinical supervision.
